days.breakfast: Warm steel-cut oatmeal with sliced banana, chia seeds, and fortified plant milk or low-fat dairy.
days.midMorning: Crisp green apple slices with sunflower seed butter (peanut-free) and a tall glass of water.
days.lunch: Hearty lentil and vegetable soup with whole-grain toasted bread and a fresh mixed green salad with olive oil dressing.
days.eveningSnack: Greek yogurt or coconut yogurt cup with fresh blueberries and a handful of pumpkin seeds.
days.dinner: Tofu or paneer stir-fry with broccoli, bell peppers, carrots, and steamed brown rice.
days.hydration: Aim for 6-8 regular glasses of water throughout the day (keep urine pale straw-colored).
days.wellnessActivity: Take a 15-minute gentle outdoor walk to refresh your mind and support natural digestion.
